title: Oven-Seared Jamaican Cucumber Salad
description: A refreshing salad featuring caramelized Persian cucumbers, perfect for a light and healthy meal.

ingredients.name: Persian cucumbers
ingredients.notes: Slice the cucumbers into 1/8-inch thick rounds

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.notes: Peel the ginger and slice into thin rounds

ingredients.name: Allspice
ingredients.notes: Grind the allspice in a spice grinder or mortar and pestle

ingredients.name: Brown sugar
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality brown sugar with a rich flavor

ingredients.name: Lime juice
ingredients.notes: Freshly squeezed lime juice adds the best flavor

ingredients.name: Coconut oil
ingredients.notes: Melt the coconut oil in the oven before searing the cucumbers

ingredients.name: Chopped fresh cilantro
ingredients.notes: Use fresh cilantro for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality salt with a rich flavor

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground black pepper for the best flavor

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C) with the coconut oil in a small ramekin.
In a small bowl, mix together the brown sugar, allspice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced cucumbers and ginger to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Place the cucumber mixture onto a robat grill or oven-safe skillet.
Sear the cucumbers in the oven for 5-7 minutes on each side, or until caramelized.
Remove the cucumbers from the oven and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
Squeeze the lime juice over the cucumbers and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
